summary.headline: FreshEdge uncovers $2.27 M in annual savings across eight indirect spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ strategic-sourcing engagement with FreshEdge has identified $2.27 million in annual savings across eight worked categories. Three categories—Crates & Pallets and Sirna & Sons’ electricity and gas—are already under signed agreements, locking in $50 K of recurring savings. A further $2.22 million is in various stages of implementation, highlighted by a $1.56 million packaging/corrugate award, a national fuel card roll-out, and utility aggregation work. Additional opportunities in waste management and P-Card optimization remain available once client pauses are lifted.
